lines.text: Most trading games ask you to trust their scoreboard.
Dream Arena hands the scoreboard to the chain.
Trade real perps on Dream Dex.
Then pick a fight: Survivor, Streak, or Boss.
The moment your position moves, Somm-nia Reactivity calls our contract, in the same block.
No keeper. No backend. No score anyone can fake.
Or let an AI agent trade for you, inside hard limits. It can never withdraw.
Dream Arena. Leverage challenges, refereed by the chain.
